title: APP Agent Card
description: Identity and capability declaration emitted at connection time by either an agent or a surface. Field applicability depends on which role is emitting: surface-only fields (surface_class, capabilities.initiation, capabilities.supports_presence) are populated only by surfaces; agent-only fields (initiation_profile, capabilities.tools, capabilities.sensor_events, device) are populated only by agents; most other fields apply to both roles. Aggregator-only fields (agent_role=aggregator, aggregates) are populated only by fleet aggregators. See SPEC.md §3.3 for the bidirectional emission lifecycle and §14 for fleet aggregators.

agent_role.description: Role this /ws/bridge connection plays. 'bridge' (default) provides events; 'aggregator' consumes bridge events via subscription (see SPEC.md §14.3). Omitting the field is equivalent to 'bridge'.

fleet_tags.description: Optional fleet-membership tags for this bridge. Open taxonomy (well-known starter list: 'irrigation', 'hvac', 'lighting', 'security', 'vehicles', 'sensors', 'meters'; implementations may use any strings). Aggregators subscribe by tag-set intersection. See SPEC.md §14.5.

voice.description: Voice capabilities. Agents declare TTS/STT providers they support; surfaces declare whether they can render synthesized voice and capture user voice input.

tts_provider.description: Text-to-speech provider identifier. Common values: 'client' (use the surface's local TTS), 'cloud', 'elevenlabs', or a vendor-specific identifier.

stt_provider.description: Speech-to-text provider identifier. Common values: 'client', 'cloud', or a vendor-specific identifier.

supports_presence.description: Whether this surface broadcasts presence_update messages with attention-state, focus-state, or user-engagement signals. Surfaces with no presence sensing should set false; surfaces with any presence input (face tracking, motion sensors, focus mode integration, etc.) set true and broadcast accordingly. Agent-only Agent Cards should omit this field.

supports_structured_options.description: Whether this surface can render agent_notification.options as discrete selectable choices and return chosen_option. When false or omitted, agents should expect free-text handling; options remain non-blocking regardless. See SPEC.md §4.13.

initiation_profile.description: Agent-side initiation disclosure for informed-consent UI. See SPEC.md §13.

surface_class.description: Class identifier this surface belongs to. Well-known values: 'phone', 'tablet', 'watch', 'desktop', 'car' (in-vehicle surfaces — Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, in-vehicle infotainment, aftermarket head units), 'smart_speaker', 'kiosk', 'ambient'. Surface implementations may use additional class names. Null or omitted for agents (which send rather than receive initiations). Agents target surfaces by this class via `agent_notification.target_surface`. See SPEC.md §5.4 and §4.13.

aggregates.description: Fleet-context block. REQUIRED when agent_role='aggregator'; absent otherwise. Surfaces render the aggregator's headline fleet view ('Irrigation Spokesperson — 247 of 300 controllers online') from these fields. SPEC §14.6 describes refresh discipline (debounced ~30s on roster changes). The 'required when agent_role=aggregator' conditional is normative in SPEC §14.6 and not enforced via JSON Schema conditionals in v0.3.

fleet_tags.description: The tags this aggregator covers. Mirrors the subscription declaration in aggregator_subscribe (§14.4).

members_total.description: Total fleet size including offline members.

last_member_change_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent bridge_online or bridge_offline event the aggregator observed. Surfaces may use this for stale-indicator UI.
